search._comment: These keywords are used to BUILD the catalog of cyber-likely positions. They are NOT a classifier. They just ensure we monitor positions that touch cybersecurity, AI safety, vehicle cyber, data protection, etc. The actual semantic classification is done offline by an LLM.

detail._comment: Detail fetch is only triggered for NEW jobs or for jobs that show real catalog-level changes. We do NOT re-download full descriptions every run. To get the full description we re-issue the same catalog search for the job's matching keyword and pick it out of the SearchResultItems — this reuses the same endpoint and pacing already validated during discovery.
